app.title: Himawari Studio
welcome.tagline: Write a visual novel and play it as you write.
welcome.sample.sunflower-demo: Sunflower Days: every feature, in English, Japanese, and Chinese
welcome.sample.festival-eve: Festival Eve: three routes, layered sprites, English and Japanese
welcome.sample.layered: Layered sprites: expressions, blinking, and lip-flap
welcome.noRuntime: The Himawari runtime wasn't found, so the preview can't play. Build it (runtime/) or reinstall Studio.
wizard.name: Name of your game
wizard.template.adv.hint: A playable scene with a character, a choice, and placeholder art.
wizard.template.blank.hint: One empty scene. Start from scratch.
coach.firstLine: Type a line. Watch it appear. →
workspace.empty: Open a scene from the left, or press Shift twice to search.
status.proposals: {count, plural, one {# AI proposal} other {# AI proposals}}
explorer.noMatch: No file or scene has that name.
explorer.deleteConfirm: Delete {file}? You can undo this in History.
editor.playHint: ▶ or Ctrl+Enter plays from a line
screenplay.hasErrors: This file has syntax errors; some rows may be missing until they're fixed.
screenplay.noScenes: No scenes in this file yet.
screenplay.goToScene: Go to a scene ({count} in this file)…
screenplay.speaker: Speaker
screenplay.condition: Shown only when this is true
screenplay.stage.textbox.adv: Textbox: one line at a time
screenplay.stage.textbox.nvl: Novel mode: lines fill the page
preview.title: Preview
preview.noRuntime: The Himawari runtime wasn't found, so the preview can't play.
preview.fixErrors: Fix the errors in Problems and the game starts here.
preview.hidden: The game is hidden while a dialog is open.
preview.staleBuild: Showing the last version without errors.
preview.fallback: Your edit removed the current line, so the game went back a little.
preview.screen.title: Title screen
output.warpFailed: Can't play from {to}: no path through the story reaches it.
output.previewExited: The preview stopped (code {code}). Press reload to start it again.
history.empty: Changes you make appear here; you can undo any of them.
history.cantUndo: Can't undo automatically: those lines changed again since.
proposals.none: No proposals. When an AI suggests a change, it waits here for you.
proposals.reason: Why? (optional, sent back to the AI)
hover.placeholder: No picture for {name} yet: a placeholder is shown.
rename.explain: Every reference in every file changes with it. You can undo it in History.
graph.summary: {scenes, plural, one {# scene} other {# scenes}} · {endings, plural, one {# ending} other {# endings}} · {unreachable, plural, =0 {all reachable} other {# not reachable}}
graph.view.allHint: Draws every scene; a big story takes a few seconds
graph.showingFile: Scenes in {name} (click a scene to open it)
characters.none: No characters yet. Add one to give lines a speaker.
characters.name: Name
characters.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and _. You type this in the script: hana "Hi!"
characters.idTaken: A character with this ID already exists.
characters.placeholderNote: Until there's art, the game shows a silhouette in this color.
characters.noSprite: No layered sprite yet. Import a PSD or ORA, put layers in {folder}, or make a placeholder in Assets.
characters.bibleHint: Personality, speech style, and what this character must never do. The AI reads this before writing their lines.
characters.presetHint: Click to try it; drag into the script to insert a show line.
characters.noPresets: No presets yet: set the layers below, then save them as an expression.
import.title: Import a layered sprite for {name}
import.explain: Top-level groups become layer groups (eyes, mouth, outfit…), and their layers become attributes. Mark names with [always], [default], or [multiple]. You can adjust everything before any file is written.
import.mapping: Writes PNG layers to {folder} on a {width}×{height} canvas. Top of the list is drawn on top.
assets.addHint: The file is copied into the project. Pictures: PNG. Sound: OGG, WAV, MP3, FLAC, or Opus.
assets.placeholderExplain: Placeholders are drawn from a name and a color, so you can keep writing before the art exists. Replace the file later with the same name.
assets.label: Text on the card
assets.hint: Drag a picture or sound into the Script view to insert it.
assets.missing: {count, plural, one {# asset is used but missing} other {# assets are used but missing}}
assets.missingHint: The game shows a labeled placeholder for these until the files exist.
assets.none: No assets yet. Missing art never blocks you: the game shows placeholders.
variables.hint: Variables remember choices (per save) or things across playthroughs, like endings seen.
variables.name: Name
variables.counts: {reads, plural, one {# read} other {# reads}}, {writes, plural, one {# write} other {# writes}}
l10n.noTargets: This game is only in its source language. Add a language to start translating.
l10n.summary: {total, number} lines · {ok, number} done · {review, number} to review · {missing, number} to translate
l10n.sync: Update the table ({added} new, {changed} changed, {removed} removed)
l10n.imported: Imported {updated, number} translations; {refused, number} refused (placeholders didn't match); {unknown, number} unknown lines skipped.
l10n.aiHint: Translated by an AI; a person should check it.
l10n.playIn: Play this line in this language
build.explain: Packages "{name}" as a folder with the game's .exe, its story, and its assets, ready to zip and share.
build.fixFirst: {count, plural, one {Fix # error first (see Problems).} other {Fix # errors first (see Problems).}}
build.laterHint: itch.io and Steam helpers come after v1. For now, zip the folder and upload it.
settings.connectClaudeHint: Chat in Claude Code or the Claude desktop app with your own plan. While Studio is open, the AI's edits arrive here as proposals for you to accept.
settings.claudeCode: Claude Code: run this once in a terminal
settings.desktopApp: Claude desktop app: add this to its config file
settings.writeMcpConfirm: Write .mcp.json into this project? Claude Code started in this folder will then offer the Himawari tools (it asks you once).
settings.liveSyncOn: Live sync is on: edits from your Claude app come here as proposals.
settings.liveSyncOff: Live sync isn't running, so a Claude app would write to the files directly.
settings.openProjectFirst: Open a project to see the setup for it.
settings.keyBilling: Uses your own Anthropic API key, billed per use by Anthropic. That's separate from a Claude subscription; to use a subscription, connect your Claude app above.
settings.keyStored: A key is stored, encrypted by Windows for your account only.
settings.cantStoreKey: Windows can't encrypt the key on this machine, so Studio won't store it.
settings.autoAcceptHint: Proposals from these tools apply without asking. All off by default.
search.placeholder: Search scenes, lines, characters, assets, commands…
history.importedSprite: Imported a layered sprite for {name} ({count} layers)
assistant.costHint: This session: {input, number} input tokens, {output, number} output tokens, {cached, number} read from cache. Billed by Anthropic to your API key.
assistant.noKey: The built-in assistant uses your own Anthropic API key. Add one in Settings to start.
assistant.modeAHint: Prefer your Claude subscription? Connect your Claude app instead (Settings → Use your Claude app).
assistant.hint: Ask for help with the story: "rewrite this line warmer", "add a choice after the festival", "translate @scene:start into Japanese". Type @ to mention a scene or character. Changes arrive as proposals for you to accept.
assistant.refusal: The model declined this request. Try rephrasing it.
assistant.aboutSelection: Asking about your selection in {file} ({chars, number} characters)
assistant.placeholder: Ask the assistant… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
proposals.conflict: Those lines changed since the AI read them, so nothing was written. The AI has been asked to read the file again.
diag.HW0001: Indentation must use spaces, not tabs.
diag.HW0002: This string is missing its closing quote.
diag.HW0004: This line is indented more than expected.
diag.HW0005: "{statement}" needs an indented block below it.
diag.HW0006: Indentation must be a multiple of 4 spaces.
diag.HW0013: Unexpected text at the end of the line.
diag.HW0015: Only menu options can appear inside a menu.
diag.HW0018: "'{'/{tag}'}'" closes a tag that isn't open.
diag.HW0021: The tag "{tag}" needs a value, like '{'{tag}=…'}'.
diag.HW0110: This character file has no valid frontmatter: {reason}.
diag.HW0132: The {element} goes past the {side} edge of the screen.
diag.HW0133: Text in {fg} on {bg} has a contrast of only {ratio}:1; at least 4.5:1 keeps it readable.
diag.HW0204: {character} has no expression or attribute called "{name}".
diag.HW0209: The scene "{name}" is defined more than once (also in {other}).
diag.HW0212: "{value}" isn't one of the values of {name}.
diag.HW0213: The {channel} "{name}" isn't in assets/{folder}/ yet; a placeholder will be shown.
diag.HW0215: The entry scene "{name}" set in himawari.json doesn't exist.
diag.HW0216: The line ID {id} is used more than once (also in {other}).
diag.HW0217: {name} isn't a string enum, so it can't be used in select.
diag.HW0220: There's no macro or extension statement called "{name}".
diag.HW0221: {name} has no parameter "{param}" (or names it twice).
diag.HW0225: The macro "{name}" is defined more than once (also in {other}).
diag.HW0226: "{name}" is both a macro and an extension statement.
diag.HW0227: A macro can't contain {statement}: each line needs its own line ID.
diag.HW0228: "{type}" can't be a macro parameter type.
diag.HW0229: A statement can have only one quoted text.
diag.HW0230: The macro {name} calls itself ({chain}); macros can't be recursive.
diag.HW0310: "return" in the scene "{scene}", which is never called.
diag.HW0320: The scene "{name}" can reach its end without jump, return, or end; the game would stop there.
diag.HW0321: The scene "{name}" is never reached from the entry scene.
diag.HW0331: Every option in this menu is "once", so it can run out of choices (it is then skipped).
diag.HW0332: A menu can have at most {max} options (this one has {count}).
diag.HW0333: One statement can change at most {max} sprite attributes (this one changes {count}).
diag.HW0403: The source of line {id} changed since this {lang} table was synced.
diag.HW0405: Line {id} is in the {lang} table but no longer in the scripts.
diag.HW0406: This string table can't be read: {reason}.
